interactions.conditions: Assert the locked #90 A-to-B interface contract exactly: J4 (board-a) pins 1-2 = +15V (Board A VBUS_OUT, post-Q1-load-switch, paired A->B conductors), 3 = ATT (STUSB4500 U1.11/ATTACH, open-drain active-low, no on-board pull-up), 4 = PDOK (STUSB4500 U1.20/POWER_OK2, open-drain active-low, asserts on a live PDO2 15V contract), 5-6 = GND (paired return). J5 (board-b) carries the identical pinout as the mating end of the same cable -- unlike the led-lamp port's Board P/Board L split, zudo-pd's contract is uniform at both ends. Verify pin-1 orientation on both layouts and end-to-end cable continuity before interconnecting boards; the connector's mechanical polarization and single-6-position-XH uniqueness rule (board-split-decision.md Keying/foolproofing) prevent a wrong-header mate, but not a miswired cable.

With power absent, inspect mating latch/key, tug-test every crimp, continuity-test all six conductors end-to-end, verify no adjacent shorts and duplicate power/ground conductors, then current-limit first power and check connector/wire temperature under maximum intended load (worst-case 3.0 A PD-contract cap against the 1.6x/2.0x derated/nameplate margin).
